findings.reason: the node either blocks on a missing entry point or edits a file outside its scope, and the interface §4 fixes (a new topology verb) is decided nowhere in the plan.
findings.text: §4's done-when is `imas-ambix agent serve deepseek-v4-1-flash --topology <name> --dry-run`, but `imas_ambix/agent/cli.py` defines no `--topology` option (its serve signature carries `--server`, `--gpus`, `--cpus`, `--port`, `--auth`, `--no-speculative`, `--dspark-block-size`, `--time`, `--dry-run`), and `imas_ambix/agent/cli.py` is not among §4's declared write paths — so the node implementing §4 as written cannot make its own done-when command run, and the three configurations it names are already expressible with the existing `--server` plus `--gpus` pair

findings.reason: run under the declared ordering the audit meets the rotation's checkpoint and reports its own positive control as failed against a correct store, so either the plan-level relationship or §2's expected row must move.
findings.text: the document's `plan-after` is `rotate-to-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` (and that plan carries `plan-blocks: b300-bring-up-and-open-model-bakeoff`), while §2's done-when at line 86 fixes its positive control as the served checkpoint reading `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` at commit `dba1be0a` — measured on 2026-10-23, i.e. the September release that the rotation's §2 replaces with `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` at commit `1bae0e10`

findings.reason: the plan's central claim (no candidate is clearly better; 1017 leads on tokens per card) rests on this row, so a citation that does not carry it and a band that is narrower than the source leave §1's decision weaker than the evidence it cites.
findings.text: the table row "8×B300 throughput relative to 1017, from the capacity study §5" carries GLM-5.3, MiMo-V2.6-Pro and Kimi K3 bands that §5 does not contain (its §5 is DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash only; the per-model projections are §6, where the like-for-like column reads 1017 2,300–3,600, GLM 600–1,400, MiMo 900–1,800, Kimi 800–1,500 tok/s) — a reader sent to §5 finds three of the four columns unsupported, and the stated Kimi band of "a fifth to a third" understates the study's own ratio (800/3,600 to 1,500/2,300, about a third to two-fifths)
